rows.name: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
rows.address_note: 3355 S Las Vegas Blvd. The poker room is at The Palazzo level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes (official poker page).
rows.resort_fee_note: Official Venetian hotel terms and the official poker suite-rate page: $55 plus applicable tax, per night stayed.
rows.room_rate_note: The official page prints poker-suite rates 'as low as $119 and $209' with no stay date attached, so no nightly value is entered. See the rate log.
rows.tax_status: Verified from the official Venetian hotel terms: Clark County Room Tax 13.38%.
rows.parking: Complimentary self-parking for non-registered guests who play three hours or more in tournaments or cash games (official poker page).
rows.cancellation_note: No cancellation deadline is printed on the poker suite-rate page. Poker-rate qualification is six hours of live cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in per night, or the rate is adjusted to the prevailing rate.

method: True nightly cost is computed only when a date-specific room rate, a resort fee, and a property-specific tax rate are all verified. No hotel row has a date-specific rate, so every true cost is blank. The Venetian terms state a $55 resort fee plus applicable tax and a 13.38% Clark County Room Tax; that rate is not copied to other properties without property-specific support.
